name: ProjectRanking
short: Weekly community voting for forum projects.
description: Adds 👍 and 👎 voting to forum project posts, tracks community votes, and promotes each week's most-liked project to a Best Creations channel with a permanent Community Favorite forum tag.
author: itsneufox
install_msg: ProjectRanking loaded! Configure it with `[p]projectrank setup <forum-id> <best-creations-channel-id> [tag name or ID]`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server and channel IDs, project thread and author IDs, project titles, weekly upvote and downvote totals, and promotion message IDs. It does not store voter identities. Project authors and bot accounts are excluded from vote totals.
